component.name: Contrast Checker
component.summary: Measure color contrast anywhere across your operating system

description.p: Contrast Checker is a minimalist, native utility for measuring color contrast anywhere across your operating system, including native windows, web browsers, virtual machines, and desktop wallpaper.

ul.li: WCAG 2.1 relative luminance calculation conforming to accessibility standards
System-wide screen color sampling via the FreeDesktop XDG Desktop Portal
Compact floating card interface with live background preview and sample text
Full keyboard navigation with high-contrast visible focus rings
Transient clipboard copy feedback and live region announcements

description.p: Initial release of Contrast Checker for Linux.
